title: BeikeShop through 2.0.0.31 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the markAsShipped handler of RmaController that allows… (CVE-2026-111657)
description: BeikeShop versions through 2.0.0.31 have an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the markAsShipped handler of the RmaController. Authenticated customers can exploit this flaw by submitting sequential RMA IDs to the account/rmas/{id}/mark_as_shipped endpoint, allowing them to modify other customers' return shipments. This includes overwriting courier names, tracking numbers, and marking approved returns as shipped without authorization.
aiSummary: CVE-2026-111657 describes an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in BeikeShop through version 2.0.0.31. The vulnerability exists in the markAsShipped handler of the RmaController, where authenticated users can manipulate the endpoint account/rmas/{id}/mark_as_shipped by submitting sequential RMA IDs. This allows unauthorized modification of other customers' return information, specifically courier details and shipment status. The vulnerability requires authenticated access and does not impact confidentiality or availability but allows limited integrity modification.
aiImpact: The vulnerability allows authenticated users to alter return shipment data of other customers, including courier names and tracking numbers, and mark returns as shipped. This can lead to data integrity issues in the returns process, potentially causing confusion or fraud in return handling. There is no impact on confidentiality or availability according to the CVSS vector. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
